   YES (hard, ~4-20%):  Argmin Select -> CRM Correction (+0.25ms) -> Execute\n         NO  (easy, ~80-96%): Argmin Select                                -> Execute\n\"\"\"\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport matplotlib.patches as mpatches\nfrom matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Polygon\nimport numpy as np\n\nplt.rcParams.update({\n    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',\n    'font.size': 9,\n    'savefig.dpi': 300,\n    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',\n    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,\n})\n\nC = {\n    'vla':      '#7F7F7F',\n    'samples':  '#E69F00',\n    'd2':       '#9467BD',\n    'decision': '#2CA02C',\n    'crm':      '#0072B2',\n    'easy':     '#1FB8CD',\n    'hard':     '#E07A1F',\n    'execute':  '#2A2A2A',\n}\n\nFILLS = {\n    'vla':      '#F2F2F2',\n    'samples':  '#FFF1DB',\n    'd2':       '#EFE6F5',\n    'decision': '#E6F5E6',\n    'crm':      '#E1EEF8',\n    'easy':     '#DCF3F4',\n    'hard':     '#FCE9D6',\n}\n\n\ndef add_box(ax, cx, cy, w, h, text, fc='white', ec='black', lw=1.4,\n            fontsize=7.5, textcolor='black',\n            boxstyle='round,pad=0.02,rounding_size=0.08'):\n    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2), w, h,\n                         boxstyle=boxstyle, linewidth=lw,\n                         edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc)\n    ax.add_patch(box)\n    ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',\n            fontsize=fontsize, color=textcolor)\n\n\ndef add_diamond(ax, cx, cy, w, h, text, fc='white', ec='black', lw=1.6,\n                fontsize=8.5, textcolor='black'):\n    pts = [(cx, cy + h / 2), (cx + w / 2, cy),\n           (cx, cy - h / 2), (cx - w / 2, cy)]\n    dia = Polygon(pts, closed=True, facecolor=fc,\n                  edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, joinstyle='round')\n    ax.add_patch(dia)\n    ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',\n            fontsize=fontsize, color=textcolor)\n\n\ndef add_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color='#333333', lw=1.3, style='-|>'):\n    arr = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),\n                          arrowstyle=style, mutation_scale=12,\n                          linewidth=lw, color=color,\n                          shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0,\n                          capstyle='round')\n    ax.add_patch(arr)\n\n\n# -------- Canvas --------\n# figsize 7.2 x 3.0 with xlim 14.5 -> 1 coord unit ~= 0.50 inch\n# 1 vertical unit ~= 0.50 inch (ylim 6)\nfig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 0.40, facecolor='#EEEEEE',\n                             edgecolor='#444444', linewidth=1.4))\nax.text(0.55, MID, r'$\\mathbf{O}_t$', ha='center', va='center',\n        fontsize=10, color=C['vla'], fontstyle='italic')\n\n# -------- Stage: K=2 samples --------\nadd_box(ax, 4.00, MID, 1.45, 0.95,\n        r'$K{=}2$ Samples' + '\\n' + r'$\\mathbf{a}^{1},\\ \\mathbf{a}^{2}$',\n lw=1.7, fontsize=8.8)\n\n# -------- Hard path (Yes) - upper --------\nhard_y = 4.65\nadd_box(ax, 9.85, hard_y, 1.25, 0.75,\n        'Argmin\\nSelect',\n        fc=FILLS['hard'], ec=C['hard'], lw=1.4,
